name: EucRoll
description: Euclidean step roll. Always records AUDIO IN. Touch rolls only on Euclidean hit steps; non-hits stay dry. X = hit density, Y = roll subdivision inside the hit, Depth = random pan width per micro-roll.

params.name: DENS
params.detail: Euclidean hits per bar that roll

params.name: ROLL
params.detail: Loop subdivision inside a hit step (1× to 8×)

params.name: PAN
params.detail: Random stereo pan depth per micro-roll
